info.title: Verix Universal API
info.description: Issue, manage, and retrieve verifiable digital credentials and credential groups in Verix.

post.description: Creates multiple credentials in Verix for a group.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

group_id.description: Target Verix group ID for credential creation.

issue.description: When true, issue created credentials immediately.

distribute.description: When true, distribute credentials immediately after issue.

inputs[].description: Array of recipient, credential, custom, and subject payload objects to create.

responseQueue.description: Queued credential records created by the request.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.

get.description: Retrieves a credential from your Verix account.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: credential_id
parameters.description: Credential ID to retrieve.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Set to json_input for nested JSON output. Default is csv_input.

schema.description: Set to json_input for nested JSON output. Default is csv_input.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

validFrom.description: ISO timestamp when the credential becomes valid.

validUntil.description: ISO timestamp when the credential expires.

custom.description: Custom fields stored on the credential.

parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.
